messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
The most popular times to visit Hawaii are **late spring (April–June)** and **early fall (September–November)**. During these periods the islands enjoy:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| Late Spring | Warm, sunny days (average highs 80–85 °F / 27–29 °C), light showers, lower humidity |
| Early Fall | Similar warmth (highs 80–86 °F / 27–30 °C), reduced rainfall, calmer seas |

These months combine comfortable temperatures, lower rainfall, and fewer crowds than the peak summer (July–August) and winter (December–January) seasons. If you’re looking for the best balance of good weather and manageable visitor numbers, aim for **April, May, September, or October**.
